name: GatewayEVM arbitrary-call USDC allowance drain (Base leg)
summary: The attacker set IsArbitraryCall on GatewayZEVM.call, so ZetaClient zeroed the sender and the TSS signed a destination execute() that routed into _executeArbitraryCall, whose onCall/onRevert-only deny-list let a transferFrom selector through; the Base GatewayEVM proxy then pulled 110,342.28643 USDC from a team wallet's pre-existing gateway allowance to the attacker EOA.

loss.notes: Exact receipt accounting: one USDC Transfer of 110342286430 units from team wallet 0x8f1aa4dc8efdb3faa5060179e90ec3572ff86e38 to attacker EOA 0x00467f5921f1a343b96b9bf71ae7e9054ae72ea4 inside the TSS-signed execute(). This record covers the single largest destination leg only; the wider campaign drained about $333,868 across 9 TSS-signed executes on Ethereum, BSC, Base, and Arbitrum, consolidated to 139.01439 ETH. No attacker-supplied campaign inputs besides gas; victim funds moved via pre-existing ERC20 allowance, not from custody inside the gateway.

ageReset.description: The fifth and final pre-incident Upgraded event selected implementation 0x1fff55ccf855212f6b5530c468b44f9a5246572e, which carries the unrestricted _executeArbitraryCall sink; the next two upgrades (blocks 45438102 and 46522899) are the post-incident patches.

sources.note: Anchor: 0x63aec3e7d9557683938cc59f22491270d2002b122ab6633e3cc2aca7078de1ec (Base block 45217913:109, 2026-04-26T17:39:33Z) is the TSS-signed execute() draining the Base leg, sent by TSS hot signer 0x70e967acfcC17c3941E87562161406d41676FD83 to the Base GatewayEVM proxy. It is the last of 8 execute() calls in the same block; the first 7 are routine gas-refuel operations to 0x701ac6fad7850956f966a85655348ac1b7c93368, while this one emits a USDC Transfer of 110342286430 units from 0x8f1aa4dc8efdb3faa5060179e90ec3572ff86e38 to 0x00467f5921f1a343b96b9bf71ae7e9054ae72ea4 plus the gateway Executed event. The attacker EOA matches the SolidityScan-attributed address controlling both the ZetaChain exploit contract 0xd9dbeec028c12d2da09a05c9d26709c0ec722bc1 and the destination receipts. No compromised-key path is evidenced on Base: execute() passes onlyRole(TSS_ROLE) because the TSS itself signed the attacker-crafted CCTX, and the transfer succeeds off the victim's pre-existing allowance. Age: proxy 0x48b9aacc350b20147001f88821d31731ba4c30ed was deployed in 0xcab7461edca3505716488d0c6c06c2deea3509f96debd53db313be34f3600fb8 at block 21980810:119; the proxy's Upgraded log series shows the final pre-incident implementation 0x1fff55ccf855212f6b5530c468b44f9a5246572e selected in 0xa8023875a7fa619a4981521e4c159e7d57e6e38eefa54669af230ce0afd1a9dc at block 38619347:21 (log 72, 2025-11-24T23:47:21Z), giving 1777225173 minus 1764028041 equals 13197132 seconds. Loss is the exact receipted USDC leg at par.
